items.heading: Seswaa
details: Key ingredients: beef or goat, onion, salt
Boil beef or goat with onion and salt until extremely tender.
Remove the meat and pound it with a mortar or two forks.
Shred the meat into fine strands, keeping some cooking liquid for moisture.
Serve the shredded meat with pap (maize porridge) and greens.

items.heading: Bogobe
details: Key ingredients: sorghum meal, water, milk or sour milk
Bring water to a boil and gradually whisk in sorghum meal.
Cook, stirring frequently, until it thickens into a soft porridge.
Stir in a little sour milk for tang and creaminess.
Serve warm as a breakfast porridge or side dish.
